strategies.title: Roots-of-unity weighted Fibonacci polynomials
strategies.approach: Define P_n(q)=sum q^{sum_{i in S} i} over nonconsecutive subsets S of {1,...,n}. Separating subsets according to whether n is present yields P_n(q)=P_{n-1}(q)+q^n P_{n-2}(q), with P_0(q)=1 and P_1(q)=1+q. For a primitive cube root omega, use a_n=(P_n(1)+P_n(omega)+P_n(omega^2))/3. At q=1 use ordinary Fibonacci growth; at omega and omega^2 examine the periodic 2-by-2 transfer matrices to derive a recurrence over n -> n+3.
